channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 15
item.description:
29 development commits

Missions & Interactions

  • Mission interactions refined: hold‑E actions now lock movement and camera and cancel cleanly; ledger and maintenance‑log reads take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after completion; safe‑pocket items are preserved when loading before the backpack.

Drones

  • Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and can strike mid‑fight.

Raiding

  • Starting a raid without a raid map now simply fails instead of causing an error, preventing crashes.

NPC & AI

  • A new apartment‑complex caretaker NPC patrols the building at night, knocks on rented doors and looks through a peephole.

Loot & UI

  • Mission loot is now revealed to players when earned, and the first loot item appears in inventory without hot‑bar outlines for clearer view.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 14
item.description:
27 development commits

Loot & Economy

  • Loot now has value‑based pricing, furniture containers have their own specific contents, and blueprints count toward inventory weight.

Combat & Enemies

  • Each enemy type now drops its own unique reward, including monument guards.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Hotbar now shows an action progress bar, indicating how long actions like building or using items will take.
  • Console window is now resizable and includes a blurred backdrop, making command input clearer and UI more flexible.
  • Error overlay stacking now respects stack‑trace order, ensuring error messages are displayed correctly.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed third-person attack alignment, ensuring attacks now line up correctly with target direction.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Nov 13
item.description:
121 development commits

Gear & Mobility

  • Added a Rocketpack for player use.
  • Implemented FPV Goggles that let players control RC units (e.g., drones) while wearing them, provided the battery isn’t empty.
  • Ground vehicles now feature a chase‑camera in third‑person view.

Combat & Survival

  • Holding **F** while wounded lets players “give up”; a timer and recovery‑chance gauge accelerate the longer **F** is held, and releasing **F** pauses the timer.
  • Gun wear reduced from 1 to 0.75 and a second HP bar now shows weapon condition.
  • Turrets now display an ammo counter without needing to power down (requires hammer and building authorization).

World & UI

  • Monuments no longer reset or respawn loot; the truck is now a full loot container and its health UI shows when breaking items; all NPCs have been removed from the world.
  • Scout drones added: they patrol small monuments, raise alarms, emit a visible light, can search for players, and have their own health pool.
  • Guards now receive loot based on tier, and dying heavy units no longer drop the client.
  • The Outpost has been removed from the raid map.
  • Hub now has its own markers, and players no longer see the map or death screen when arriving.

Economy & Base

  • Supplies shop prices increased; every item now has a defined value and loot above‑grade gear is treated as made gear.
  • Introduced a Tier‑2 Container Shelter (solo/duo legacy shack) with a Tier‑2 tech tree but Tier‑0 workbench; it can be destroyed and currently has no balanced craft costs.

Explosives

  • Flash grenades now have zone‑based effects (inner 2 m, mid 6 m, outer 10 m) with varying flash strength, duration, deafness, and name‑tag visibility; looking away only mitigates mid/outer zones, and heavy flash also muffles sound like a heavy plate helmet.
  • Explosion damage radius changed to full damage within 1.75 m falling to zero at 3.75 m; shrapnel adds up to 30 bleed within 2 m, fading out to 8 m, requires line‑of‑sight, and visible shrapnel streaks are now shown.
